source_note: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0
english_source_note: Lp Decay Rates Ensuring Almost Everywhere Convergence to 0
callout_id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#4
statement_en: Let \(\{f_n\}\) be a sequence of Lebesgue measurable functions such that \(\|f_n\|_{L^p(\mathbb{R})}^p \leq a_n\), where \(p \geq 1\), and let \(\{a_n\}\) be a nonnegative sequence with \(\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n\) convergent. Then \(f_n(x) \to 0\) almost everywhere.
callout_body: Lebesgue可测函数列$||f_n||_{L^p(\mathbb{R})}^p\leq a_n$其中$p\geq 1$，并且非负序列$a_n$满足$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$收敛，那么$f_n(x)$几乎处处收敛到0。
